draft: draft-sahu-agent-action-receipts-01 (vectors 01-18 are unchanged from the -00 suite; 19-21 and the head assertion exercise -01 additions)

vectors.note: three receipts, genesis has no prev_hash
actor absent on genesis: omission is total (no member, no separator)
unknown members (source, vendor_ext) are ignored by the signature but covered by the chain
nested objects sort recursively; arrays keep order; RFC 8259 minimal string escaping; integers only
one signed value edited: its signature fails AND the next link breaks
every signature valid; ordering violation surfaces only in the chain
a line replayed twice; the chain breaks AND the repeated step_id is flagged
HONEST LIMIT: last record dropped, everything verifies clean; only an external head assertion detects this (draft Security Considerations)
validly signed, but the first record must not carry prev_hash
validly signed, but a non-genesis record must carry prev_hash
public_key not exactly 64 lowercase hex chars must be rejected
THE DIFFERENTIATOR: an unsigned extension member is edited — every signature still passes, but the chain (over raw transmitted octets) breaks

REPETITION with an intact chain: the recorder re-emitted an already-recorded action as a new, validly signed, validly linked position - only the repeated step_id gives it away; a verifier that checks signatures and linkage but not step_id uniqueness reports clean

ORDERING (-01 seq profile): signed per-chain sequence numbers 0,1,3 - the chain is intact (nothing was removed from THIS file) but the signer's own numbering shows positions are missing; distinguishes a gap from mere absence, which linkage alone cannot
ORDERING (-01 seq profile): sequence numbers 0,1,1 - the signer assigned the same position twice (a fork made sequential); intact chain, valid signatures, caught only by the signed seq

head_vectors.note: signed head assertion (chain_id = sha256 of the genesis line, count, head digest) over the intact 3-line chain; signature is domain-separated with the ASCII prefix agent-receipt-head-v1:
the SAME assertion against vector 14 (which is 01 truncated at the head): count 2 != 3 and the head digest differs - the external state that catches what vector 14 shows the chain alone cannot
